blocks.text: Idaron ko yaqeeni banana hai ke un ka cloud istemal data privacy, hifazat aur sanati miyaron ke qanooni aur zabtai taqazon ke mutabiq ho, jo ilaqe aur sanat ke hisab se badalte hain. Providers aksar in taqazon ko poora karne ke auzaar dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Hospital ko kyun parwah ho sakti hai ke us ka cloud data kahan rakha hai?
blocks.explanation: Mareezon ki privacy ke qawaneen tibbi data ki hifazat aur manzoor shuda jagahon par rakhne ka taqaza kar sakte hain, to hospital ko qawaneen ke mutabiq provider aur settings chunni hongi.

items: Compliance: cloud istemal data privacy, hifazat aur sanati qawaid ke mutabiq ho.
